subject: Copywriting
title: AI and the Future of Sales Letters
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: AI and the Future of Sales Letters.

hook.text: GPT models can generate a complete sales letter in minutes. But can AI write a letter that runs profitably for 28 years?

buildup.text: AI excels at generating variants, A/B testing copy, and personalizing at scale. Speed and volume are its strengths.

discovery.text: Early tests show AI copy matches human copy for short-form. For long-form sales letters, human writers still outperform.

twist.text: The Wall Street Journal letter worked because Martin Conroy understood human ambition.

climax.text: The future: AI writes the first draft, humans add soul. Efficiency and insight are complementary, not competitive.

punchline.text: AI writes fast. Humans write deep. Together, they write best.

quiz.question: Where does AI currently outperform humans in sales copy?
options: Generating variants and A/B testing at scale
